question: Should OpenClaw accept this experimental, cross-repository Claws package contract—including the gated CLI, grouped manifest, and lifecycle/provenance boundary—as the direction for implementation?
rationale: The RFC introduces new public product and configuration surface across OpenClaw and ClawHub; source review can assess coherence, but cannot determine whether this is the intended durable product model.

options.title: Accept experimental direction
options.body: Accept the RFC as the gated Claws direction and review implementation PRs against its stated compatibility and ownership constraints.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Request a smaller RFC that settles only the agent/package model while deferring lifecycle or CLAW.md portability commitments.

options.title: Continue incubation
options.body: Keep the RFC open while maintainers gather implementation and ecosystem feedback before accepting a shared contract.

recommendation.title: Accept experimental direction
recommendation.body: Accept the RFC as the gated Claws direction and review implementation PRs against its stated compatibility and ownership constraints.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review supplied the most concrete product-model and schema direction in the available discussion.
